description: This file defines the LanguageService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing business logic for managing language entities, including CRUD operations, and interactions with the LanguageDao data access object.

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: Service class managing language-related operations in the OrangeHRM system, including CRUD operations and validation.

methods.name: getLanguageDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of LanguageDao.

methods.name: setLanguageDao
methods.description: Sets the LanguageDao instance for the service.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Saves or updates a Language entity in the database.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of languages matching given search filters.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of languages based on search parameters, ordered by name.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple Language entities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks whether a language name already exists in a case-insensitive manner.
